parameters.query: with input_json as (select $1::jsonb as p), input_data as (select nullif(p->>'workflow_run_id','') as workflow_run_id, nullif(p->>'idempotency_key','') as idempotency_key, case when nullif(p->>'workflow_run_id','') is not null then 'workflow_run_id' when nullif(p->>'idempotency_key','') is not null then 'idempotency_key' else 'missing' end as request_identifier_kind, ((nullif(p->>'workflow_run_id','') is not null) or (nullif(p->>'idempotency_key','') is not null)) as status_request_valid from input_json), matched_run as (select r.* from moex_n8n_workflow_runs r cross join input_data d where (d.workflow_run_id is not null and r.workflow_run_id = d.workflow_run_id) or (d.workflow_run_id is null and d.idempotency_key is not null and r.idempotency_key = d.idempotency_key) order by r.created_at desc limit 1), latest_events as (select e.* from moex_n8n_workflow_run_events e where e.workflow_run_id = (select workflow_run_id from matched_run) order by e.event_id desc limit 20), event_summary as (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('event_id', event_id, 'previous_state', previous_state, 'new_state', new_state, 'event_type', event_type, 'created_at', created_at) order by event_id), '[]'::jsonb) as events, count(*)::integer as event_count from latest_events), latest_event as (select event_id, new_state, event_type, created_at from latest_events order by event_id desc limit 1), latest_steps as (select s.* from moex_n8n_workflow_step_runs s where s.workflow_run_id = (select workflow_run_id from matched_run) order by s.created_at desc, s.started_at desc nulls last limit 20), step_summary as (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('step_name', step_name, 'status', status, 'attempt', attempt, 'input_hash', input_hash, 'output_hash', output_hash, 'started_at', started_at, 'completed_at', completed_at, 'error_message', error_message) order by started_at nulls last, created_at), '[]'::jsonb) as steps, count(*)::integer as step_count from latest_steps) select d.status_request_valid, d.request_identifier_kind, (r.workflow_run_id is not null) as found, r.workflow_run_id, r.idempotency_key, r.status, r.current_state, r.repository_full_name, r.current_phase, r.target_branch_name, r.pr_ref, r.pr_number, r.final_pr_head_sha, r.ci_status, r.validation_verdict, r.durable_evidence_ref, r.pre_ci_branch_artifact_ref, r.final_pm_l2_evidence_ref, r.fallback_route, r.error_message, r.locked_by, r.worker_execution_id, r.claim_token, r.lock_expires_at, r.last_heartbeat_at, r.heartbeat_count, r.retry_count, r.max_retries, r.next_retry_at, r.last_completed_step, r.github_branch_name, r.github_commit_sha, r.github_pr_url, r.created_at, r.updated_at, coalesce(e.event_count, 0) as event_count, coalesce(e.events, '[]'::jsonb) as events, le.event_id as latest_event_id, le.event_type as latest_event_type, le.new_state as latest_event_state, le.created_at as latest_event_created_at, coalesce(s.step_count, 0) as step_count, coalesce(s.steps, '[]'::jsonb) as steps from input_data d left join matched_run r on true left join event_summary e on true left join latest_event le on true left join step_summary s on true;
